sanskrit_verse:
viṇmūtrodakavaprāṃś ca vahniśvabhraniveśanam /
aratnidvayam utsṛjya parakuḍyāṃ niveśayet // BrhS_1,19.50
transliteration:
viṇmūtrodakavaprāṃś ca vahniśvabhraniveśanam /
aratnidvayam utsṛjya parakuḍyāṃ niveśayet // BrhS_1,19.50
sph_interpretive_translation: One who discharges urine or water near fire or in a hole must abandon two ratnis of land and establish boundaries with another's wall.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from spatial integrity and elemental harmony
Causation arises through violation of sacred placement and environmental sanctity
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by awareness of elemental conduct
Restoration logic demands removal from corrupted space and re-alignment with dharma-based geography
Consciousness alignment requires purification through boundary-setting and land relinquishment
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent discharges impure substance within proximity to elemental fire OR subterranean cavity THEN REMOVE_TWO_RATNI_AREA_FROM_USE_BY_AGENT
IF violation occurs THEN ESTABLISH_NEW_BOUNDARY_WITH_ADJACENT_WALL AS_RESTORATIVE_MEASURE
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, this principle establishes that violations involving elemental disharmony necessitate not punitive sentencing but immediate spatial correction. The court must ensure that the responsible party surrenders control over contaminated zones and enforces new demarcations aligned with neighboring structures to preserve collective energetic balance.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that disturbance of elemental order creates sequential misalignment (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility aligns proportionally with knowledge of such disruption. There is no infliction of pain; rather, the violator assumes completion through withdrawal from corrupted domain and reintegration via boundary establishment. This reflects the non-punitive reality rule wherein consciousness realigns through action, not suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Surrender usage rights over contaminated area equivalent to two ratnis
Boundary Re-establishment Protocol: Erect physical demarcation linking adjacent wall to restore structural and energetic continuity
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Conduct ritual cleansing of affected zone post-relinquishment under supervision of qualified dharmic administrator
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. Spatial harmony prevails through conscious realignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
